question: Which complaint types with more than 3000 total requests from 2011 to 2020 show the strongest positive and negative Pearson correlations with the daily average wind speed measured at station 744860 (JFK Airport), based on daily complaint proportions (the ratio of type-specific complaints to total daily complaints)? Please provide the complaint types and their correlation coefficients, rounded to four decimal places.

WITH complaint_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        complaint_type
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_date) BETWEEN 2011 AND 2020
    GROUP BY complaint_type
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 3000
),
daily_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE(created_date) as complaint_date,
        COUNT(*) as total_complaints
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_date) BETWEEN 2011 AND 2020
    GROUP BY DATE(created_date)
),
qualifying_types AS (
    SELECT complaint_type FROM complaint_totals
),
all_dates AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT complaint_date FROM daily_totals
),
date_type_combos AS (
    SELECT ad.complaint_date, qt.complaint_type
    FROM all_dates ad
    CROSS JOIN qualifying_types qt
),
daily_complaint_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE(created_date) as complaint_date,
        complaint_type,
        COUNT(*) as type_count
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_date) BETWEEN 2011 AND 2020
    GROUP BY DATE(created_date), complaint_type
),
daily_proportions AS (
    SELECT 
        dtc.complaint_date,
        dtc.complaint_type,
        CAST(COALESCE(dcc.type_count, 0) AS FLOAT64) / CAST(daily_totals.total_complaints AS FLOAT64) as proportion
    FROM date_type_combos dtc
    JOIN daily_totals ON dtc.complaint_date = daily_totals.complaint_date
    LEFT JOIN daily_complaint_counts dcc 
        ON dtc.complaint_date = dcc.complaint_date 
        AND dtc.complaint_type = dcc.complaint_type
),
wind_speed AS (
    SELECT 
        PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', CONCAT(year, mo, da)) as weather_date,
        CAST(SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) AS FLOAT64) as wdsp
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
    WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2020'
      AND stn = '744860' 
      AND wban = '94789'
),
combined AS (
    SELECT 
        dp.complaint_type,
        dp.complaint_date,
        dp.proportion,
        ws.wdsp
    FROM daily_proportions dp
    JOIN wind_speed ws ON dp.complaint_date = ws.weather_date
),
agg AS (
    SELECT 
        complaint_type,
        COUNT(*) as n,
        SUM(proportion) as sum_prop,
        SUM(wdsp) as sum_wdsp,
        SUM(proportion * wdsp) as sum_prop_wdsp,
        SUM(proportion * proportion) as sum_prop_sq,
        SUM(wdsp * wdsp) as sum_wdsp_sq
    FROM combined
    GROUP BY complaint_type
),
correlations AS (
    SELECT 
        complaint_type,
        ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(
            n * sum_prop_wdsp - sum_prop * sum_wdsp,
            SQRT((n * sum_prop_sq - sum_prop * sum_prop) * (n * sum_wdsp_sq - sum_wdsp * sum_wdsp))
        ), 4) as pearson_correlation
    FROM agg
    WHERE n > 0
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        complaint_type,
        pearson_correlation,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pearson_correlation DESC) as pos_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pearson_correlation ASC) as neg_rank
    FROM correlations
)
SELECT complaint_type, pearson_correlation, 'strongest_positive' as type
FROM ranked
WHERE pos_rank = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT complaint_type, pearson_correlation, 'strongest_negative' as type
FROM ranked
WHERE neg_rank = 1
